primary_citation: SFARI Gene All Human Gene Data 2026 Q2. Abrahams et al. (2013), DOI 10.1186/2040-2392-4-36.
observed_rights_scope: Terms identify public-source data and ask for original-source and SFARI attribution. No bulk mirror scope is required here.

reconstruction: Match frozen SHA256 ec3b830ab3f4e185d4d912b6e46a9bca79db39fafd107b37d8b48421be4772d2. Retain score 1 symbols, join exact HGNC symbols or uniquely resolvable aliases, exclude collisions and preserve unmeasured status.

observed_rights_scope: Source is a publisher article with source-specific rights. Article access availability does not grant a blanket mirror of its attachments.
release_representation: Canonical screen results, project-derived measured/test/FOXP3 direction fields, selected program descriptors and independent abstracted published facts.
source_exclusion: Exclude original XLSX/PDF/ZIP tables, author/named sample fields and any raw sequence files.
access_instructions: From the publisher article use Supplementary Table 1 for the core MAGeCK screen and published controls, Tables 3–5 when checking program/provenance statements. The exact source files and SHA256s are listed in SOURCE_RIGHTS_R1_EXCLUDED_FILES.tsv.
reconstruction: Match the published gene-level sheet to the frozen canonical IDs. Native LFC remains in source orientation. A hit requires positive or negative author FDR <=0.05. Apply the frozen high/low-bin interpretation checked with published controls.

primary_citation: Chen et al., DDBJ GEA E-GEAD-649, RNA expression references
observed_rights_scope: GEA documents its open database and places human submission responsibilities on data owners. Retain source attribution and keep original files at the source.
release_representation: Gene-level aggregated mean log2(CPM+1), detection flags and gene mapping decisions. No run counts or original sample sheets.
source_exclusion: Source archive, study/sample sheets, library-level counts and raw files excluded.
access_instructions: Use the exact listed E-GEAD-649 processed ZIP, IDF and SDRF. Use the filelist checksums and the source checksums recorded here.
reconstruction: Normalize each valid count run with the column sum before gene mapping. iTreg NTC detection requires >=2/3 runs in each of two design groups. For hTreg/hTconv, require >=3/4. Use CPM 0.5/1/2 and mean per-run log2(CPM+1) on resolved symbols. The Umhoefer primary Treg reference is cross-study. Retain reference-missing separately.
